title: KDWAS Human Annotation Task
description: Each mission requires human experts to annotate the ground truth along 6 dimensions.

annotation_fields.human_annotation: Expert-written natural language justification for the optimal action sequence
annotation_fields.annotator_trust_score: Score 1-5: How confident is the annotator in this assessment?
annotation_fields.rationale_quality_score: Score 1-5: How well does the reasoning chain justify each step?
annotation_fields.mission_alignment_verified: Boolean: Does the optimal action sequence align with the stated mission constraints?
annotation_fields.causal_completeness_score: Score 1-5: Are all causal links between market events, KG state, and actions identified?
annotation_fields.error_type_if_applicable: Category: hallucinated_action, risky_decision, protocol_misunderstanding, mission_violation, or null

annotator_trust_score.1: No confidence — annotator lacks domain expertise
annotator_trust_score.5: Very confident — expert in this specific protocol

rationale_quality_score.3: Adequate — covers main steps but misses edge cases
rationale_quality_score.5: Excellent — comprehensive, considers alternatives and risks

causal_completeness_score.5: All causal links traced through KG, including indirect effects
